items.title: S Size Weather
items.text: Keep starving throughout the growth cycle to obtain this quality. Weather effect lasts for 2 days.

items.title: M Size Weather
items.text: Slightly starve during the growth cycle to obtain this quality. Weather effect lasts for 3 days.

items.title: L Size Weather
items.text: Maintain zero hunger throughout the growth cycle to obtain this quality. Weather effect lasts for 5 days.

items.title: S Size Soil
items.text: Keep starving throughout the growth cycle to obtain this quality. Has a 50% chance to turn into Barren Soil after harvest.

items.title: M Size Soil
items.text: Slightly starve during the growth cycle to obtain this quality. Has a 40% chance to degrade to S Size after harvest.

items.title: L Size Soil
items.text: Maintain zero hunger throughout the growth cycle to obtain this quality. Has a 20% chance to degrade to M Size after harvest.

items.title: Normal Quality
items.text: Standard quality awarded when growing conditions are not fully met.

items.title: Decay Quality
items.text: Low quality yield obtained when all growing conditions remain poor. Yields more reputation than Normal quality when appraised.

items.title: Star Quality
items.text: High quality yield obtained when all growing conditions are kept perfect. Yields the highest reputation when appraised.

items.title: Garden Shears
items.text: Use the garden shears to remove weeds. Weeds slow down flower growth.

items.title: Harvest
items.text: Harvesting when a plant is fully mature gives double the yield.

items.title: Watering
items.text: Each watering raises moisture by 10. Moisture retention depends on the soil type and resets daily.

items.title: Spade
items.text: Use the spade to scoop soil out of pots. Swapping soil to match your plants helps them thrive.

items.title: Level Up
items.text: Once you have enough plants, it's time to level up! Tip: Growing a variety of plants makes leveling up easier.

items.title: Reputation
items.text: This is reputation. You can earn it by trading items via mail.

items.title: Points
items.text: Points can only be acquired through purchase.

items.title: Mailbox
items.text: A random plant is delivered to your mailbox every day. Remember to check it!
